findings.finding: The manifest declares scene-clinical-wrap-up to have no material claims, but content/080-clinical-wrap-up.md teaches and applies ordered concentration ratios, proportional scaling, dimensional substitution, part-whole percentage, percent change, and the percentage-point distinction. It also contains multiple quantitative conclusions. The scene has no source note, no claim maps to it, and the relevant glossary entries omit it, so this material teaching content escapes the candidate's evidence chain.
findings.resolution: Either remove the material teaching content and leave a genuinely non-evidentiary routing scene, or set the scene to claims-mapped, add scene-clinical-wrap-up to every applicable claim and glossary entry, and add a same-scene source note listing every supporting source.

findings.finding: The record says checked-no-agent-restriction-found, but the current cited OpenStax page explicitly says the book may not be used in training or otherwise ingested into large-language-model or generative-AI offerings without permission. That conflicts with the recorded access state. This source is the sole declared support for claim-proportion-equation and claim-percentage-part-whole, so those central claims lack an independently usable source under the academic-review procedure.
findings.resolution: Replace OpenStax with an authoritative source whose current terms permit the planned agent access, or classify it as human-only and add the required documented human verification or permission while ensuring each central claim retains complete eligible support.

findings.finding: Every claim is already marked reviewed even though lesson.json identifies this exact candidate as draft with pending-review source confidence and ATTRIBUTION.md records a later clinical-framing revision. Because material candidate changes stale earlier reviews, these values overstate the academic status of version 0.2.0.
findings.resolution: Return all current-candidate claims to pending-review until the fresh finalizer disposes the reviews and records the permitted post-adjudication status transition.
